channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Trump says Iran negotiating with US
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that Iran is negotiating with the United States. "The plan is that (Iran is) talking to us, and we'll see if we can do something.

item.title: Gold, silver prices dip 7 to 9 pc as aggressive profit taking continues
item.description: Gold and silver prices continued their sharp decline on Sunday, as investors booked profits post an unprecedented rally over the past year.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee to meet CEC tomorrow on SIR issue, hold series of meetings in
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee will be meeting the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC), Gyanesh Kumar, at the Election Commission of India (ECI) headquarters in New Delhi on Monday.

item.title: Delhi Dangal Warriors to face Haryana Thunders in blockbuster PWL 2026 final
item.description: Delhi Dangal Warriors booked their place in a thrilling final of the Pro Wrestling League 2026 after edging past Maharashtra Kesari in a pulsating semi final 2 at the Noida Indoor Stadium on Saturday night.

item.title: Telangana CM orders action against those responsible for excise constable’s death
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy on Sunday directed the police to take strict action against those responsible for the death of excise constable Gajula Soumya.

item.title: Mahesh Kumar Goud Expresses Grief Over Death of Excise Constable Injured in Ganja Smugglers’ Attack
item.description: In a statement, Mahesh Kumar Goud said the news of Soumya’s death while undergoing treatment at NIMS Hospital was extremely painful and distressing. He said the constable had suffered serious injuries while trying to prevent illegal ganja smuggling in the line of duty.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open nearly flat on Budget Day
item.description: The Indian equity markets on Sunday traded with increased volatility, amidst Budget caution and a weak rupee hovering near 92 per dollar.

item.title: Kolkata warehouse fire death toll rises to 27; many still missing
item.description: The death toll from the fire incident at the Anandapur warehouses, situated on the southern outskirts of Kolkata, has increased to 27, while 25 individuals remain unaccounted for, according to officials on Sunday.

item.title: Wife Aayesha Shroff wishes “Happppppiest birthday to the BEST of the BEST’ Jackie Shroff
item.description: Wife Aayesha Shroff wished husband Jackie Shroff "Happppppiest birthday" with a sweet social media post. She showered praises on the 'Hero' actor, calling him 'the best of the best'. Aayesha said that Jackie puts his all into every role of life - a friend, a father, and an actor.

item.title: BJP makes budget for country’s 5 per cent, giving benefits to its own people: Akhilesh Yadav
item.description: As Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget 2026, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav launched a sharp attack on the BJP on Sunday, alleging that the government prepares budgets only for a small section of society.
